'''Janeiro's Point''' is a small island just outside [[Booty Bay]], upon which a giant statue of a [[goblin]] with outstretched arms was built as a beacon to all travelers. 

The [[sea giant]] [[Mok'rash the Cleaver]] has chosen the island as his abode.

==Trivia==
*The statue and its name are obviously a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Christ the Redeemer (statue)|statue of Christ the Redeemer]] in [[Wikipedia:Rio de Janeiro|Rio de Janeiro]], a symbol of the city and of the nation of Brazil.
